name: Average Precision
baseline_or_reference_per_seed: pi_(t,s)=P/n of that seed's eval set (never 0.5)

name: Brier
baseline_or_reference_per_seed: pi(1-pi) of that seed's eval set

name: ECE (10 equal-width bins)
low_support_rule: n<500 or P<20 -> LOW_SUPPORT; bin n_k<10 flagged

name: False alerts per hour/day
change_vs_v1: DROPPED: eval set varies by seed; not shown to be the full population; revive only with local confirmation of ts + coverage + full population

name: Precision at budget K
formula_or_rule: E[TP_K]/K; K=ceil(b*n) b in {.001,.005,.01,.05} or K in {100,1000}; boundary tie r*a/g

name: FAM_RECALL_BUDGET@K
scope: ranking and K on full E_(t,s)
formula_or_rule: E[TP_f in top-K]/P_f; boundary tie r*a_f/g
